name: Browse Abandonment Flow (3 Emails + 1 SMS)
purpose: Window shoppers are comparing with competitors. Position the brand as the better, safer choice.

source.note: Fluid flow system v2, distilled from 31 client strategies (fluid-flow-strategist skill)

profileFilter.description: Added to Cart zero times since starting this flow
Started Checkout zero times since starting this flow
Placed Order zero times since starting this flow
Not in the Abandoned Cart flow

actions.job: Show the viewed product and why this one beats the alternatives
subject: Still thinking about this?
actions.name: Email #1: Reminder

all: Dynamic block with the viewed product
replenishable: Why this one beats the alternatives (ingredients, testing, results, value)
one_off: Answer the doubt for that category (fit, sizing, compatibility, quality)

actions.job: Reviews for what they viewed, plus the browse incentive
subject: Everyone is loving {{brand.name}}
actions.name: Email #2: Reminder + Social Proof + Incentive

all: Reviews tied to the viewed product or category
one_off: Keep the incentive light on high-ticket items

actions.job: Simple reminder of what they were viewing
actions.body: Still thinking about {{event.ProductName}}? It's waiting for you: {{event.URL}}

actions.job: The viewed product is still waiting; the code expires tonight
subject: Sh… Don't tell anyone about this
actions.name: Email #3: Reminder + Incentive Expiry
actions.topic: Sh… Don't tell anyone about this

all: The viewed product is still waiting

notes: SMS #1 follows Email #2 (what most reference docs do; a few pair it with Email #1).
